newsitem.title: USA: Daleen makes secure Internet software.
newsitem.headline: Daleen makes secure Internet software.

text.p: Daleen Technologies Inc said on Friday it has developed software for secure commercial transactions over the Internet and corporate Intranets.

Any standard World Wide Web browser running Java Applets, a software language based on Sun Microsystems Inc's Java, on any supported workstation can conduct business without any security concerns, Daleen said.
The method used by Daleen was to develop a communication library that works in conjunction with Java Applets, allowing several transactions to take place at once, Daleen said.

Java is the new programming language which has made the applications being developed on the Internet accessible to all computer users regardless of the type of computer or operating system being used, Daleen said.
Applets are small application programs that flow between computer networks to create animation, stock market updates or multimedia advertisements, the company said.
